items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Second brother, what he sang was Celestan, Ferdinand Joseph.

ctx.x: Roman and Columbus. Can you tell us anything about your family? If you had any other musicians in the family?

I did. Yeah, my father he was a bass player but he didn't play bass, you know, music. My oldest brother he was a drummer. Second brother, what he sang was Celestan, Ferdinand Joseph. Oh yes. Yeah, he sang this on Decker label, this My Josephine.
